results.title: Ethics and Innovation in Organic Dairy Farming - Springer Nature
results.content: What values do consumers of organic dairy products hold regarding naturalness and related attitudes toward animal ethics? The participants expected organic farms to put animal welfare before profit maximization: *“[…]species-appropriate husbandry should always come before profit maximization […]I think it should be the case that the dairy farmer (who tries to initiate something) is thinking along those lines*, *rather than saying ‘That’s too expensive for me*, *I’m not going to implement it’ even if it might go beyond the standard”* (P6; m; u; IOB; FG1\_pos. For example, several participants reported that they now consume less meat and dairy products or at least think about consuming fewer animal products and would like society to do the same: *“People should generally drink less cow’s milk and use milk alternatives”* (P15; f; r; ROB; FG2\_pos.
